description: One creator in, one small answer out: is this creator known bad, with the rug rate, the chain baseline and the multiple that justifies the verdict. The cheapest call on this server -- use it when all you need is the decision rather than the wallet list. known_bad is null, never false, for a creator we have no record of. The data behind it is a batch export, so a creator who launched in the last hour is not in it yet; every response carries the timestamp it was generated.

chain.description: Which chain the creator launched on.

creator.description: Creator address. base58 for Solana, 0x... for Robinhood Chain.

name: groundtruth_creator_flag
